title: Prune Ruby Gemfile.lock
description: Generates an app-scoped Gemfile.lock from the monorepo's unified root Gemfile.lock — pruned to the app's dependency closure with the path-gem `remote:` re-anchored to the app directory. The Bundler analogue of `@nx/js:prune-lockfile`.

rootLockfile.description: Root unified Gemfile.lock, relative to the workspace root.

gemfile.description: App Gemfile to read direct dependencies from, relative to the project root.

outputLockfile.description: Pruned lockfile destination, relative to the project root. Keep in sync with the target's `outputs`.
